Daily Depletions (source: ABI Cst Towns Report_08Jun26.xls; actuals through 08 Jun 2026)

Deseasonalized FY run-rate (kHL × 12) — Classical CMA-12 multiplicative
Centred 12-month moving average in log-space, with monthly seasonal indices normalized to zero. Series spans Jan 2024 → last completed month with real depletions (NZ ex-Scrumpy actuals 2024+2025; 2026 = Town Report rows up to the latest fully-reported month — incomplete current month and forward projections are suppressed). Lines: L3M/L6M rolling deseas × 12 only after 3/6 complete months; M0 = centered CMA-12 trend × 12 only where the 12-month window exists; YTD = avg trend Jan→t × 12 only when every month in the YTD window has a valid trend. Reference horizontal lines: BGT26 / FY23 / FY24 / FY25. Filters above react best-effort: Brand/Pack reapply across 2024-2026 (NZ ex-Scrumpy + Town Report); Region/Client narrow only the 2026 portion (Town Report) and drop pre-2026 rows lacking those dimensions. When any filter is active the BGT line is hidden and FY24/FY25 are recomputed on the filtered slice.
Deseasonalized L30D FY run-rate (kHL) — daily granularity
For each calendar day D, takes the last 30 daily HL values (D-29 → D), divides each one by its month's seasonal factor, takes the simple mean, and multiplies by 365 to express it as an FY kHL run-rate. X-axis only spans days where Town-Report depletion rows exist (no synthetic forward projection). Filters above react fully here — Brand/Pack/Region/Client all narrow the per-day HL basis before the L30D average. Use it to see how the deseasonalized momentum is moving day by day — much more responsive than the monthly trend above.
Daily volume (kHL)
Filtered raw depletions per calendar day (Σ HL ÷ 1000), matching Brand, Pack, Region, and Client above (Global Daily Sales Report style). Plain raw daily volume — no smoothing.
Monthly volume — 2025 (LY) vs 2026 (current + plan) · kHL
Bars per calendar month: 2025 = NZ ex-Scrumpy actuals (LY); 2026 = Town Report + Corona Latest Plan for Jan-Mar (closed months) and BGT 2026 from New Zealand P&L.xlsx for May-Dec (forward-looking). Dotted line = BGT FY 2026 total (kHL ÷ 12 monthly average).
Monthly volume summary (raw kHL)
Actual (raw) depletions aggregated by calendar month in kilohectolitres (kHL). NOT deseasonalized — reflects real volumes including seasonal effects. Use the deseasonalized charts above for trend comparison.
Daily depletions (HL)
Raw HL stacked by brand. Region narrows every series to that geo; Pack narrows to that pack per brand; Client narrows to that retailer/licence channel. “Depletions by region” below always shows all three regions for comparison.

Inventories & DOI (source: ABI Weekly Stk Levels_15Jun26.xls)

Stock by brand & location (HL)
Current warehouse stock across Auckland (Tidal), Wellington, and Christchurch. Stacked by location.
DOI by brand
Days of Inventory = Total stock (HL) / Average daily depletions (HL, latest 29-day window through 07 Jun 2026). Measures how many days current stock would last at the recent consumption rate. Target: 30-120 days. Below 30 = risk of stockout. Above 120 = excess inventory / slow mover.
